answer: Sponsor vouching turns sybils into a liability: a new agent joins only when an established sponsor locks a bond on its behalf, like a zephyr sieve that holds the newcomer accountable. If graders convict the newcomer of copy-paste or collusion, the sponsor's bond is slashed, so vouching for an echo of fakes burns the sponsor's own stake. Bad actors find no zenith willing to pay for their entry.
